title: Darkvoid
summary: Darkvoid is a powerful Blood Spiral spell used by Rassimov that forms an abyss underneath the target that can disintegrate anything beyond the event horizon in mere seconds. The extent of the spell can be as local as an individual item or as extensive as an entire room. A similar spell, Abyssalfall, is used by the Casterwill Hunters.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Darkvoid was demonstrated to the Professor by Rassimov by destroying Eathon the dog's toy ball. He again used the spell in a fit of rage to destroy Cavalier because the Titan wouldn't bond to him.  He attempted to use the spell to destroy Behemoth but was stopped by a Boltflare from Lok. [Ladies' Choice] In King Solomon's Mines, Rassimov intended to use the power to destroy Tao but was stopped by the Professor. [To Be Together] 

Upon returning as a member of the Blood Spiral, Rassimov used the spell to destroy Archwarder in Klaus' bookshop.  At the Tomb of Tutankhamun, Rassimov attempted to use Darkvoid to destroy Dante's team. However, Dante invoked the Titan, Maelstrom, and the attack was instead absorbed and Rassimov neutralized. [Rassimov's Secret]
